title: C: Hash Table
description: Implement a hash table with string keys and integer values using separate chaining for collision resolution.

steps.title: Hash Function and Insert
steps.description: Implement a hash table with 8 buckets. Define a `KeyValue` struct node for the linked list chain. Write `unsigned int hash(char *key)` and `void insert(KeyValue **table, char *key, int val)`. Test with 3 entries.
hints: Hash function: sum of char values modulo table size.
Insert at head of the chain at table[hash(key)].

verification.failureMessage: Print all buckets with their key-value pairs

steps.title: Hash Table Search
steps.description: Write `int search(KeyValue **table, char *key, int *result)` that returns 1 if found, 0 otherwise. Search for 'banana' and 'grape'.
hints: Traverse the linked list comparing keys with strcmp.

verification.failureMessage: Search for banana (found) and grape (not found)
